HAARKLOUS PLASS 17A · TORSHOV · OSLO

Haarklous online

Walk the neighbourhood, go home to your 4th-floor apartment (street door of 17A, up the stairs), go into the stairwells, ride the Honda CBF600, drive the parked cars or the excavator, work the machines on the construction site, play paintball, disc golf in Torshovdalen and petanque in the park, take photos, and start the hostage-rescue mission at the red marker beside the entrance of number 17A. Play together: up to twelve players per lobby – your lobby code is in the pause menu.

    Controller: △ enter a lobby code · □ back to your own lobby · Share: quick chat in the game · Keyboard: Enter or T to chat

    Motorcycle / car
    □ get on/in · R2 throttle · L2 brake/reverse · left stick steer · right stick look
    Excavator
    L1/L2 left track forward/back · R1/R2 right track · left stick: swing and stick · right stick: boom and bucket
    Disc golf / petanque
    Aim with the camera · hold R2, release to throw · ○ quit
    Construction site
    North in Torshovdalen, through the gate: dozer, 30 t excavator, wheel loader, hauler, tipper truck, mobile crane and tower crane · □ climb in · R2 / L2 drive (excavator: L1/L2 R1/R2 tracks) · right stick (or the arrow keys) works the blade, bucket, body or boom · mobile crane: L1 outriggers · cranes: ✕ hook or set down a load · R3 / V view: cab, outside, above the hook
    Paintball
    Walk into the lobby outside the course gate (the first one there is the admin) · ↑↓ team · admin: ←→ game, △ paint / reball, hold ✕ start · in a game: R2 / left mouse fire, L2 / right mouse aim, □ / R reload, hold △ leave
    Helicopter
    Mode 2: left stick ↑↓ collective (centre = hover), ←→ pedals · right stick pitch and roll · R3 / V chase camera · □ get out after landing
    Plane
    Mode 2: left stick ↑↓ throttle (stays where you leave it), ←→ rudder and nose wheel · right stick pitch and roll (pull back to lift off at about 95 km/h) · L2 brakes · R3 / V view
    FPV drone
    Hold △, pick the drone · left stick ↑↓ thrust, ←→ yaw · right stick tilt (angle) or rates (acro) · L1 / Q angle ↔ acro · ✕ reset after a crash · ○ pack away
    Multiplayer
    Up to twelve players per lobby (code above) · □ next to a vehicle someone is driving: ride along as passenger (motorcycle, cars, helicopter, plane) · Share / Enter: chat
    Firepit
    In the park in front of the building: □ sit on a bench, R2 have a beer, □ at the woodpile throws a log on the fire
    Shops
    Joker and Kiwi at their real places: □ takes an item, pay at the till, □ at the machine returns empty bottles (2 kr each) · D-pad ↓ / ↓ opens your bag · money: missions, disc golf, petanque, bottle deposit
    Stashes
    Three hidden crates around the neighbourhood: □ snort a line or use the needle for a random 30-second boost – 3× running speed, 3× jump height or bullet time
    Drinks
    Beer and aquavit in the apartment: each beer or sip = 30 s drunk
